mapper.insert: INSERT INTO layer_unmatched (layer, doi, issn, container_title) VALUES (#{layer}, #{doi}, #{issn}, #{containerTitle}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT issn, max(container_title) AS container_title, count(DISTINCT doi)::int AS dois, max(first_seen) AS last_seen, min(doi) AS example FROM layer_unmatched WHERE layer = 'BLR' AND issn IS NOT NULL AND issn <> '' AND first_seen >= #{since} GROUP BY issn ORDER BY issn
